svg.title: Building the ProviderSet from settings (start-up and every provider rebuild)

g.text: Building the ProviderSet from settings (start-up and every provider rebuild)
each builder below calls endpoint_for(ctx, component, service, base_url)
base URL set and valid http(s)?
then NotConfigured("... API key is not set")
| Some(Err) -> warning only, main model used
[want_ocr (vision OcrOnly, or use_ocr for a vision model)]
Some(WindowsOcr) on Windows, else None -> set.ocr
The engine never refers to a concrete provider: Engine::set_providers / EngineDeps receive the set,
and refresh_provider_health() marks Llm / Transcription / Vision Active, Error (with the issue message) or Disabled;
Embeddings stay Active (built-in hashing embeddings when no provider is set).
API keys are only read through SecretResolver; they never appear in errors, logs or SQLite.
